plugins.name: agent-adversarial-challenger
plugins.description: Read-only adversarial challenger: independently stress-tests any claim, plan, design, hypothesis, decision, or conclusion -- technical or not -- by attacking its assumptions and returning evidence-backed counter-arguments and alternatives, without changing anything. The critic half of a generate/critique loop; debugging escalation, debate devil's-advocate, research and decision review are all applications.

plugins.name: agent-coder
plugins.description: Implementation subagent for bounded code changes, tests, and refactors within a defined scope.

plugins.name: agent-external-repo-worker
plugins.description: Subagent that works inside an external repository outside the caller project. Handles isolated clone or reuse, convention discovery, bounded edits, local verification, and delegated publish or PR work.

plugins.name: agent-pr-reviewer
plugins.description: Subagent that reviews pull requests for code quality, security, and best practices.

plugins.name: agentic-maintenance
plugins.description: Maintain your agentic assets: audit and optimize steering, look up prompts, write new skills, with the coder and PR reviewer agents. Includes Hobson documentation-standards and plugin-eval for evaluating external packages.

plugins.name: audit-steering
plugins.description: Audit agent rules, hooks, skills, and guardrails for drift, duplication, stale files, and token waste.

plugins.name: catchup
plugins.description: Resume interrupted project work by locating and following the best handover before doing fresh discovery, after context loss, /clear, or a continue/resume request.

plugins.name: chezmoi-editor
plugins.description: Edit chezmoi-managed dotfiles from their authoritative source files. Use when changing dotfiles, global agent/tool config, templates, private files, symlinked config, or any live target that may be managed by chezmoi.

plugins.name: code-intelligence
plugins.description: Codebase understanding toolkit: graph/index/search skills (codebase-index, codebase-memory, explore, prompt-lookup), research and web-fetch, the PR reviewer agent, project-structure steering, and Hobson documentation/architecture plugins.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review a diff, change set, or PR for bugs, regressions, security risks, and missing tests, reporting findings by severity.

plugins.name: codebase-index
plugins.description: Rebuild the codebase-memory graph index when it is missing or stale. Requires the codebase-memory-mcp binary; without it, fall back to grep/glob exploration.

plugins.name: codebase-memory
plugins.description: Structured graph queries against the indexed code graph: trace callers/callees, find references, map architecture. Requires the codebase-memory-mcp server; for lightweight orientation, use explore.

plugins.name: commit-push-merge
plugins.description: Commit local changes when needed, push, and merge a branch after inferring or confirming the target and merge method.

plugins.name: commit-push-pr
plugins.description: Commit local changes when needed, push, and open or update a pull request for review.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Baseline bundle for any repo: layers the project-lifecycle, code-intelligence, and agentic-maintenance sub-bundles, plus resume-session, the Matt Pocock grill workflows, and the Hobson context/orchestration plugins.

plugins.name: core-global
plugins.description: Recommended global (user-scope) baseline: the bootstrap workflow skills shipped directly, plus the reusable global skills and agents pulled in by dependency. Install with 'apm install core-global@srobroek-agentic --global'.

plugins.name: data-ai
plugins.description: Data and AI toolkit: data steering plus Hobson LLM application, data engineering, MLOps, database design, migrations, and cloud optimization plugins.

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Deep tradeoff analysis for architectural decisions, technology choices, and feature proposals. Tests an idea from both sides before recommending a path.

plugins.name: debugging
plugins.description: Local debugging escalation: the unstuck skill and the adversarial-challenger agent for when you are blocked. For production/distributed incident debugging, see the incident-response bundle.

plugins.name: developer-tools
plugins.description: Everyday developer tooling: Hobson developer-essentials, debugging, comprehensive review, git/PR, and documentation-generation workflows.

plugins.name: diagrams
plugins.description: Diagram generation bundle for editable draw.io diagrams, visual Excalidraw diagrams, and D2 architecture or flow diagrams.

plugins.name: docs-architecture
plugins.description: Documentation and architecture: Hobson documentation standards, code documentation, doc generation, and C4 architecture workflows.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explain a topic at five depth levels, from metaphor to frontier, for layered understanding of unfamiliar concepts.

plugins.name: explore
plugins.description: Lightweight read-only codebase orientation: file discovery, path tracing, and "where is X" lookups. For structured graph queries, use codebase-memory.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend development and design toolkit: the Playwright browser skill, frontend steering, and external design/build skills (Impeccable, Interface Design, Stitch) plus Hobson frontend, UI, accessibility, and landing-page plugins.

plugins.name: go-quality
plugins.description: Run Go format, lint, and test checks with the project toolchain.

plugins.name: governance
plugins.description: Agent governance: Hobson MCP protection, signed audit trails, review policy, and no-verify blocking workflows.

plugins.name: handover
plugins.description: Save a self-contained recovery prompt to the shared handover store when pausing work, switching context, preserving unfinished state, or handing off to another session.

plugins.name: headroom
plugins.description: Run coding agents through Headroom to compress context and cut token usage (~60-95% fewer) and to read token-savings stats.

plugins.name: hooks-bash-safety
plugins.description: Bash safety guards: block privilege escalation, curl|sh pipes, and obviously destructive filesystem ops; soft-confirm rm -rf on non-system paths and hard- block it on system-critical paths. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).

plugins.name: hooks-branch-check
plugins.description: Branch awareness hook: on prompt submit, warn when work starts on a protected branch (main/master/develop) and surface relevant feature branches/worktrees. Advisory context only, never blocks. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).

plugins.name: hooks-git-safety
plugins.description: Git safety guards: hard-block `git reset --hard`, and soft-guard other destructive git operations — confirm (ask) on checkout --/restore/clean -f/branch/stash/tag deletion/worktree remove, warn-and-proceed on force push — plus throttle large gh CLI batches toward a rate-limit-aware helper. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).

plugins.name: hooks-git-workflow
plugins.description: Opt-in git workflow hooks: warn (non-blocking) on commits when tests are stale or failing, track edit-vs-test state, and warn about uncommitted work at session end. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).

plugins.name: hooks-no-ff
plugins.description: Opinionated git policy hook: require --no-ff on git merge so feature-branch history is preserved. Blocks fast-forward merges. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).

plugins.name: hooks-quality
plugins.description: Opt-in code-quality hooks: advisory linting/formatting feedback after edits and a quality check before commits. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).

plugins.name: hooks-squash-merge
plugins.description: Opinionated git policy hook: require an explicit merge strategy on gh pr merge (--squash for feature PRs, --merge for release PRs). Blocks strategy-less PR merges. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).

plugins.name: hooks-tool-prefs
plugins.description: Opinionated advisory hook: suggest preferred tools over deprecated ones (rg over grep, fd over find, pnpm over npm, uv over pip, mise over nvm/pyenv, just over make). Advisory only, never blocks. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).

plugins.name: hooks-worktree
plugins.description: Worktree lifecycle hooks: create worktrees outside the repo tree (in /tmp) to prevent nesting, and clean up the worktree directory and branch on removal. Claude WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove events.

plugins.name: hyperresearch
plugins.description: Thin APM wrapper that routes to the upstream third-party HyperResearch deep research harness for long-form, source-backed research reports.

plugins.name: incident-response
plugins.description: Incident response and production debugging: Hobson error-debugging, distributed-debugging, incident-response, error-diagnostics, and debugging-toolkit plugins for diagnosing failures in running systems.

plugins.name: infrastructure
plugins.description: Infrastructure and operations toolkit: infrastructure steering plus Hobson cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, deployment, deployment-validation, and observability plugins.

plugins.name: language-arm-cortex
plugins.description: ARM Cortex-M firmware toolkit: Hobson's embedded arm-cortex-microcontrollers specialists.

plugins.name: language-dotnet
plugins.description: .NET development toolkit: Hobson's C# and ASP.NET dotnet-contribution specialists.

plugins.name: language-functional
plugins.description: Functional programming toolkit: Hobson's Elixir and Haskell functional-programming specialists.

plugins.name: language-go
plugins.description: Go toolkit: the go-quality skill, opinionated Go steering, and Hobson's systems-programming specialists.

plugins.name: language-julia
plugins.description: Julia development toolkit: Hobson's scientific-computing julia-development specialists.

plugins.name: language-jvm
plugins.description: JVM language toolkit: Hobson's Java, Scala, and enterprise jvm-languages specialists.

plugins.name: language-python
plugins.description: Python toolkit: the python-quality skill, opinionated Python steering, and Hobson's python-development specialists.

plugins.name: language-rust
plugins.description: Rust toolkit: the rust-quality skill, opinionated Rust steering, and Hobson's systems-programming specialists.

plugins.name: language-shell
plugins.description: Shell scripting toolkit: Hobson's Bash and POSIX shell-scripting specialists.

plugins.name: language-steering-go
plugins.description: Opt-in opinionated Go defaults: prefer the standard library, urfave/cli for CLIs, koanf for layered config. Install to adopt these picks; the language-go package carries the non-opinionated structural conventions.

plugins.name: language-steering-python
plugins.description: Opt-in opinionated Python defaults: tooling (uv, Ruff, pytest, pyright) and libraries (FastAPI, Pydantic, Litestar). Install to adopt these picks; the language-python package carries the non-opinionated structural conventions.

plugins.name: language-steering-rust
plugins.description: Opt-in opinionated Rust defaults: cargo/clippy/rustfmt, thiserror for libraries, anyhow for binaries, clap for CLIs. Install to adopt these picks; the language-rust package carries the non-opinionated structural conventions.

plugins.name: language-steering-terraform
plugins.description: Opt-in opinionated Terraform and HCL defaults: module preference order, remote state with locking, version pinning, and plan/validate discipline. Install to adopt these picks; the language-terraform package carries the non-opinionated structural conventions.

plugins.name: language-steering-typescript
plugins.description: Opt-in opinionated TypeScript and JavaScript defaults: tooling (Bun, pnpm, Vitest) and contracts (Zod, OpenAPI). Install to adopt these picks; the language-typescript package carries the non-opinionated structural conventions.

plugins.name: language-terraform
plugins.description: Terraform and HCL toolkit: opinionated Terraform steering plus Hobson's deployment-strategies specialists. No dedicated quality skill yet.

plugins.name: language-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript and JavaScript toolkit: the typescript-quality skill, opinionated TS/JS steering, and Hobson's javascript-typescript specialists.

plugins.name: language-web-scripting
plugins.description: PHP and Ruby web scripting toolkit: Hobson's web-scripting specialists.

plugins.name: matt-skills
plugins.description: Bundle of Matt Pocock's engineering and productivity skills: grill-me, grill-with-docs, tdd, to-prd, to-issues, triage, improve-codebase-architecture, and setup.

plugins.name: mcp-codebase-memory
plugins.description: MCP server package for the Codebase Memory MCP, providing graph-aware project orientation (symbol search, call paths, code snippets).

plugins.name: mcp-context7
plugins.description: MCP server package for Context7, providing current library and framework documentation lookups.

plugins.name: mcp-package-version
plugins.description: MCP server package for Package Version, providing dependency version discovery before adding or upgrading packages.

plugins.name: mcp-playwright
plugins.description: MCP server package for Playwright, providing browser automation and in-browser UI verification.

plugins.name: mcp-repomix
plugins.description: MCP server package for Repomix, providing bulk repository snapshots for analysis and review.

plugins.name: mcp-serena
plugins.description: MCP server package for Serena semantic code tools. The launcher selects the Codex or Claude Code context from the parent harness and can be overridden with SERENA_MCP_CONTEXT.

plugins.name: mcp-tauri
plugins.description: MCP server package for Tauri, enabling AI assistants to build, test, and debug Tauri v2 apps — UI automation, IPC monitoring, log streaming, mobile device listing, and plugin setup.

plugins.name: optimize-steering
plugins.description: Audit and optimize agent-facing markdown (steering docs, skills, agent definitions) for token efficiency and cross-model compliance (rules R1-R7).

plugins.name: planning-product
plugins.description: Planning and product toolkit: the debate, eli5, research, and web-fetch skills plus Matt's PRD, issue-writing, TDD, triage, and architecture-improvement workflows.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Automate browser tasks through a Playwright MCP server: navigate, click, fill forms, and extract page data.

plugins.name: presentation
plugins.description: Presentation bundle for general decks, Marp slides, and PowerPoint template workflows.

plugins.name: project-lifecycle
plugins.description: Day-to-day project lifecycle workflows: resume work after interruption (catchup), write handovers, run verification, and commit/push via local merge, PR, or quick commit. Bundles the matching skills and the PR reviewer agent.

plugins.name: prompt-lookup
plugins.description: Find, compare, and improve prompt templates and prompt-engineering patterns from prompt libraries: search, retrieve by ID, and enhance prompts.

plugins.name: python-quality
plugins.description: Run Python format, lint, type-check, and test commands with the project toolchain.

plugins.name: quick-commit
plugins.description: Create a deliberate local git commit without pushing or opening a PR, for checkpoints and fast commit-only workflows.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Multi-source research synthesis for comparisons, technology evaluations, and tradeoff analysis. Not for single lookups (explore) or URL fetches (web-fetch).

plugins.name: resume
plugins.description: Resume bundle for focused resume tailoring and broad career-support workflows.

plugins.name: resume-session
plugins.description: Resume a previous agent session in the current repository from its transcript, reading only the latest context incrementally instead of reloading the full history. Discovers prior Claude Code and Codex sessions, summarizes the leftoff state, confirms ambiguities, then continues the work.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Code review and verification toolkit: the code-review and verify skills, the PR reviewer agent, and Hobson comprehensive-review, performance-testing-review, unit-testing, and tdd-workflows plugins. Language-specific quality checks live in the language-<lang> bundles.

plugins.name: rust-quality
plugins.description: Run Rust format, lint, and test checks with the project toolchain.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security toolkit: Hobson security-scanning, security-compliance, backend-api-security, frontend-mobile-security, and reverse-engineering plugins for vulnerability analysis, compliance, and hardening.

plugins.name: sniff
plugins.description: Audit a codebase for stability, hardening, and cleanup opportunities, finding latent issues across error handling, structure, concurrency, and input boundaries.

plugins.name: speckit
plugins.description: SpecKit mechanism: the six SpecKit agents and the bugfix and setup skills. Opt into the opinionated layers separately: steering-speckit (the mandatory-gated workflow) and speckit-dag-hooks (the DAG dispatcher + enforcement hooks).

plugins.name: speckit-dag-hooks
plugins.description: Opt-in enforcement hooks for the SpecKit DAG: hard-block out-of-order or precondition-violating /speckit.* commands via the speckit-dag dispatcher. Opinionated mandatory-gating -- requires the speckit package (which ships the dispatcher) to be installed.

plugins.name: steering-backend
plugins.description: Opinionated backend conventions: service/function/worker runtime shape, API and cross-boundary contract rules, and background-job (queue, event, scheduled) patterns. Opt-in steering.

plugins.name: steering-data
plugins.description: Opinionated data conventions: data ownership, database assets, migrations, pipelines, and notebook practices. Opt-in steering.

plugins.name: steering-docs-specs
plugins.description: Opinionated documentation and spec conventions: durable docs structure, markdown practices, project-doc placement, and the SpecKit spec-workflow conventions. Opt-in steering.

plugins.name: steering-frontend
plugins.description: Opinionated frontend conventions: framework choice by surface (React/Vue/Next/Astro), UI library picks, app vs server state, and browser verification expectations. Opt-in steering -- install to adopt these frontend defaults.

plugins.name: steering-infrastructure
plugins.description: Opinionated infrastructure conventions: platform code, IaC, deployment config, CI/CD, environments, and observability. Opt-in steering.

plugins.name: steering-pragmatic
plugins.description: Opinionated pragmatic working style: prioritize accuracy, calibration, and decision usefulness over agreeableness. Analytical and direct by default; distinguish facts from assumptions; avoid hype and sycophancy. Always-on steering. Opt-in.

plugins.name: steering-project-structure
plugins.description: Opt-in steering: capability-first repository structure and ownership conventions -- repo layout, ownership boundaries, shared libraries, contracts, and where docs/specs/tools live.

plugins.name: steering-speckit
plugins.description: Opinionated SpecKit workflow steering: the mandatory-gated Phase 1/2/3 DAG, human-gating rules, and command reference. Opt-in -- install alongside the speckit package to adopt this specific spec-driven process.

plugins.name: steering-subagent-routing
plugins.description: Opt-in steering: model routing and verification policy for delegated subagents -- when to delegate, model/effort choice, parallel work, and who owns verification.

plugins.name: steering-toolchain-defaults
plugins.description: Opt-in steering: opinionated default stack choices for frontend, infrastructure, and quality/observability. Install to adopt these defaults when setting up or standardizing a project.

plugins.name: steering-tools-scripts
plugins.description: Opinionated conventions for repo tooling and automation: where scripts, generators, maintained CLIs, and task runners live and how they are structured. Opt-in steering.

plugins.name: typescript-quality
plugins.description: Run TypeScript or JavaScript format, lint, type-check, and test commands with the project toolchain.

plugins.name: unstuck
plugins.description: Escalate stalled debugging by challenging assumptions after the normal diagnosis loop has failed and the agent is going in circles. Ships an outcome-gated stuck detector (re-edit churn, failure streaks, flip-flops) with an escalating nudge/directive/edit-gate ladder on both runtimes.

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Run and report a final local verification pass (tests, types, build, lint) before handoff, commit, push, merge, or PR.

plugins.name: web-fetch
plugins.description: Retrieve current or URL-specific information from the web with source-aware tool routing for fetching, browsing, citing, and verifying online.

plugins.name: write-a-skill
plugins.description: Create or rewrite agent skills with precise triggers, progressive disclosure, references, scripts, and source-of-truth placement.
